title: Thick slab
what: Exactly the locked content: the head, the title and the six rows, with row 06 'Your part' as the only orange element. The form adds no words: it adds thickness (real side walls), a lit chamfer round the top, an inner frame, rows cut into the plate as recessed lanes, and two thinner draft plates behind.
why: A standard should feel substantial and lasting, so the document is one solid plate instead of a sheet of paper; the earlier drafts behind it are thinner, so the current version reads as the one that has gained weight. Every contribution is a lane cut into that plate, and row 06 is a lane already cut and left open, outlined in orange: a reserved place in the Standard waiting for you.
how: Each plate is a top face plus four walls built with 3D-transformed elements (30px deep for the slab, 10px and 6px for the drafts). Volume comes from tone only: lit top arris and chamfer band, a lighter right wall, a shaded bottom wall, and lanes with a dark top wall and a lit bottom lip; no shadows or glows. On load the drafts slide out, the slab settles, then each lane is cut left to right and its row writes in (about 1.2s). The pointer tilts the hero subtly, and hovering or focusing row 06 tints its lane and steps its text in. Reduced motion shows the final state with a plain fade. On mobile the plate goes flat, keeps a bottom edge to show its thickness, and row 06 stays a tap target taller than 44px.
